title: an idle session goes dormant, and the pane you protect does not
asserts: a core that advertises `reaper` honours the two frames a client steers it with. A session left alone for the idle window is flagged dormant on the wire (a sessionMeta carrying dormant: true) and only then killed, so the row a client keeps says "slept, wake me on demand" rather than "died"; a session the client has declared protected survives the same window untouched, because sleeping the pane somebody is looking at is visible work vanishing under them; and reactivate brings it back with the flag cleared, which is the one click that has to make the moon go away. The live-session ceiling travels on the same frame and is driven here, but which session it evicts is asserted in the core's own suite, where the session set is controlled - a conformance run shares one daemon with every scenario before it, so an LRU order over that daemon's whole session list is not a fact this file can pin.

steps.note: start from a known policy: a conformance daemon is shared with every scenario before this one, and the boot default is whatever the harness set
the pane the client has open; the core must never sleep it
idle reaping on with a window this scenario can wait out; the ceiling stays off so nothing else can decide to sleep this session
five times the window, and it has to survive all of it. The assertion is scoped to this session: the daemon may legitimately be sleeping sessions other scenarios left behind
and it is still alive, not merely un-flagged
the client looked away; an empty list clears this connection's whole set
the flag lands while the pty is still alive: flagging after the kill would leave the exited row looking like a crash
and only then is the CLI process tree freed, which is the whole point of sleeping it
off before waking, or the session is eligible again the moment it is back
one click resumes it and the moon clears
this scenario's own cleanup: it woke a session, so it ends it
leave the daemon as it was found, so a scenario that runs after this one is not measured against a reaper this one switched on
